debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

syslog_log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog (e.g., LOG_LOCAL0).

log_file.description: Path to the log file when syslog is disabled.

api_paste_config.description: Path to the PasteDeploy configuration file for the API.

rpc_backend.description: RPC backend (e.g., rabbit, fake, or kombu).

transport_url.description: Messaging transport URL (e.g., for RabbitMQ, Redis, or Kafka).

fernet_keys_dir.description: Directory containing Fernet keys for token encryption.

enabled_share_drivers.description: List of enabled share driver modules.

name.description: Fully qualified class path for the share driver.

default_share_type.description: Name of the default share type to use if none specified.

manage_share_servers.description: Enable management of dedicated share servers (for multi-tenancy).

network_api_class.description: Network API class to use for IP allocation / DNS integration.

max_shares_per_tenant.description: Maximum number of shares allowed per tenant.

max_share_snapshots_per_tenant.description: Maximum number of share snapshots allowed per tenant.

share_replication.description: Enable share replication for high availability.

share_export_location_format.description: Format string for share export location path.

scheduler_filter_classes.description: List of scheduler filter classes to apply when scheduling share creation.

scheduler_weight_classes.description: List of scheduler weighter classes to score backends.

service_token_required.description: Require service tokens for internal service-to-service communication.

service_token_expires.description: Service token expiration time in seconds.
